snippet.title: Toada Brava - Official Demo Announcement Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Take a look at the Demo Announcement Trailer for Toada Brava, a hand-drawn 2D top-down RPG developed by Asteristic Game Studio and Mateus Grazina. Players will take on fight after fight to aid Kako in the search for his mom. Aid the revolution in Toada Brava, coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo coming soon to Steam.
